title: AndroidLife: Real-Phone Android Agent Benchmark for Open-Weight Models and On-Device SLMs
description:
AndroidLife is a real-phone Android agent benchmark for open-weight models and on-device SLMs, with a 60-task public set and a 530-task dataset.

The harness and tooling are licensed under Apache-2.0. Task definitions, schedules and published evaluation artifacts are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
